messages:
mira: quick findings from a 10min a11y pass on the Activity Cards in the Models list — posting screen recording + notes. main probs: focus trap when opening card actions, low contrast on status pills, missing aria-label on the copy key, and keyboard skips the compact actions.

sam: thanks — looks helpful. can you paste the clip + repro steps? i'll try to reproduce locally. :+1:

mira: clip: https://clips.internal/clip-2175 (screenflow) repro steps in order:
1) tab to model row -> hit Enter to open actions flyout
2) use arrow keys to move inside the flyout
3) press Esc to close -> focus does NOT return to the original row, it goes to the top nav instead
4) tab through compact mode -> the inline copy icon is not reachable with keyboard

frank: confirmed in VoiceOver and NVDA. on mac VoiceOver rotor, the dialog isn't exposed as a dialog role — it's just a div. That explains the focus loss. Also saw that the status pill text #6B7280 on white is ~2.8:1 — under 4.5:1 for small text. :warning:

olivia: that focus return is a big regression for keyboard users. any quick fixes we can ship in a patch release?

sam: short-term patch: set role="dialog" on the flyout container, add aria-modal="true", and on close explicitly call focus() on the trigger element. longer term we'll refactor to a focus manager util.

mira: also propose changing pill color to #1F2937 for the text (dark slate) which gets us to 7.8:1 vs white. this keeps the pill background the same (soft gray #F3F4F6) so contrast improves without redesign.

frank: agree on the color swap. for the copy button: add aria-label="Copy model id" and make it a real button (not clickable div). ensure it has :focus-visible outline 3px solid #2563EB (blue-600) and that we don't hide focus with box-shadow hacks.

sam: noted. regarding keyboard reachability for compact actions: they used tabindex="-1" on the icon wrapper. quick fix is remove tabindex and ensure wrapper isn't interactive; move interactive to the <button> inside. i can push a PR with those changes + regression test.

mira: one more nit — table headers in the models list lack scope="col"; screen readers can't announce column header relationships on large lists. can we add scope attributes programmatically in the table component?

frank: yes, add <th scope="col"> for columns. also add aria-sort when sorting is applied. small but helps screenreader users a lot.

a11y-bot: Automated scan summary: 6 failures, 3 warnings. Top issues: non-descriptive button (copy icon), insufficient contrast (status pill), missing dialog role (action flyout). See full report: https://a11y.internal/report/2175

olivia: timeline? if sam can PR today, can we get a hotfix tomorrow? i want to include this in the patch notes.

sam: i'll open the PR in ~2 hours. label it patch/hotfix. i'll include unit tests for focus return and an axe check for pill contrast.

mira: perfect. i'll update the design token for pill text and add a short copy blurb for the release notes: "improved accessibility for action menus and status badges".

frank: after the PR lands i'll re-run manual VoiceOver/NVDA passes and give the thumbs up before release. thanks y'all :)
